fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darting bolts of water that spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Their damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Upstream Leap
fusions.desc: Springs along a stream of water to an enemy up to 7 tiles away, where it deals 12 water damage and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggle Loose
fusions.desc: Frees you from up to 2 control effects, then your movement speed rises by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Darting Run
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
